suites.name: issue-ui
checks: one new-chat entry and unified model control
multiple image thumbnails precede text and open an accessible preview
drag and clipboard paste add image previews to the active draft
Markdown attachments open a safe file preview
failed uploads remain retryable and prevent Enter from dispatching
$ skill selection uses keyboard and @ adds a real plugin reference
process defaults collapsed, time advances and final reply stays visible
history images preview after refresh
workspace file selection is available only through the composer plus menu
same-thread provider change and full-access selection persist
skills use compact equal-height rows with row-click details and protected-source uninstall
one tools page groups plugin-owned connections and keeps independent MCP actions available before testing
gateway settings use a single list with defaults
gateway and connector editors open focused dialogs and cancel without changes
plugins install, toggle and uninstall through the unified page without model calls
a custom gateway default applies to new chats without replacing the current conversation model
gateway editing hides internal IDs, has balanced spacing and stores keys through a private binary channel
a lost key-save response is reconciled by reading the ticket without resending a secret or creating duplicates
standalone personal skills uninstall with confirmation and remain absent after refresh
an implicit account gateway opens a read-only detail instead of a create form
gateway, tools and skill settings fit mobile in both themes and the editor remains scrollable in landscape
mobile and both themes fit without horizontal scrolling

suites.name: skills-ui
checks: native display name, descriptions, scope and enabled state
formatted skill document is readable and executes no embedded content
reader focus and return focus remain in the settings dialog
source view preserves complete frontmatter and text
disabled skill can be viewed without enabling or writing configuration
existing enable and disable controls still save native configuration
reload reads current content; missing and undiscovered skills fail and recover
empty and metadata-only documents have useful states
unsafe, oversized and invalid-text files show bounded errors without secret content
network errors can retry and returning while loading cancels stale content
discovery errors and native warnings are visible and refreshable
closing and refreshing keep the read-only viewer available
dark mode and 375px controls remain readable and tappable
landscape leaves readable page space and keeps reader controls visible
older backends keep native skill controls and hide unsupported document actions
session expiry while reading returns to login

suites.name: skills-use
checks: search, enabled state, multiple selection and removable draft chips
sending uses native skill input and stores an immutable message reference
multiple selected skills preserve order and remain separate from message text
changed content rejects dispatch and retains draft until the user reselects
disabled selections cannot execute and historical references still identify the original skill
missing files reject sends; historical missing or removed skills show recoverable errors
cancelled selection cannot append a stale skill to a different draft
refresh and reconnect restore the original message references without duplicating them
new chat clears unsent skill selection and preserves historical references
mobile picker, chips and history viewer fit the viewport with 44px controls
landscape selection and history actions stay visible

suites.name: interaction-ui
checks: login keeps native password manager semantics and shortcuts cannot navigate away
skip link reaches the composer and keyboard focus remains visible
IME composition and Safari 229 Enter keep text without creating a turn
Shift Enter adds a line and a plain Enter submits exactly once
search shortcut traps Tab and Escape restores its composer launcher
settings prevents global shortcuts from replacing its draft and restores its button
menu keyboard actions open rename and return focus to the surviving menu trigger
nested private-input dialog blocks shortcuts, returns within settings and never consumes a credential
system appearance follows OS changes while explicit light preference stays fixed
rich text uses the selected theme for code, formulas, diagrams and ECharts
secondary text meets contrast across both themes and common surfaces
appearance survives reload and reduced motion disables product animations
mobile sidebar is modal, contains focus and Escape restores the toggle
mobile sidebar menus layer above the drawer and nested settings return to navigation
mobile controls have 44px targets and input fields avoid automatic text zoom
320px layout keeps the composer and search usable without horizontal overflow
landscape and short viewport settings keep close and focused fields reachable
drawer breakpoint changes leave no stale focus trap or hidden desktop workspace

suites.name: app-host-ui
checks: standard SDK initialization and runtime diagnostics agree on tool scope, sandbox and unadvertised capabilities
the compact capability disclosure is keyboard operable and shows per-view tool scope without claiming permission
message returns an explicit denied result and a safe Host notice
link returns an explicit denied result and a safe Host notice
download returns an explicit denied result and a safe Host notice
context, resource enumeration, resource reads, prompt/tool discovery, sampling and unknown methods return JSON-RPC errors without disconnecting
fullscreen and picture-in-picture requests report inline as the actual mode
logging is not collected and unsupported actions cause no extra model, resource, tool, download or navigation activity
a tool linked to another UI resource is refused without an approval dialog or tool execution
an unsupported App request cannot dismiss, replace or approve a pending tool decision
a permitted tool still requires a fresh one-use approval and runs once
reopening with no App-visible tools removes serverTools from the handshake and does not grant tool access
mobile dark-mode capability disclosure stays readable, within the viewport and has a 44px keyboard target
Host restrictions preserve lifecycle close/reopen and isolate browser execution and network access
